runtime.gpu_name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti Laptop GPU
runtime.kernel_resources_note: CUDA Driver function attributes after PTX JIT. Local-memory size can include stack, spills and compiler-managed arrays; it does not measure executed spill traffic or achieved occupancy.
runtime.memory_note: Static device buffer allocations only; excludes CUDA context, PTX module/JIT, embedded constants and possible local-memory spills. This is not a measured GPU-memory peak.
runtime.memory_snapshot_note: cuMemGetInfo point samples of the whole device; may include other processes and driver allocations. These samples are not this process's measured peak.
runtime.timing_note: GPU interval includes device work and any host submission gaps; excludes PTX JIT, transfers, file I/O and warmup. Trace mode synchronizes every dispatch and is not a throughput measurement. Transfers use host API wall time.
